title: Nebuchadnezzar's Dream

questions.question: What troubled Nebuchadnezzar in the second year of his reign so that his sleep left him?
questions.explanation: Daniel 2:1 (ESV): "Nebuchadnezzar had dreams; his spirit was troubled, and his sleep left him."

questions.question: What did the king demand the wise men to tell him regarding his dream?
questions.explanation: Daniel 2:5 (ESV): "if you do not make known to me the dream and its interpretation, you shall be torn limb from limb"

questions.question: Who revealed the mystery of the dream to Daniel?
questions.explanation: Daniel 2:19 (ESV): "Then the mystery was revealed to Daniel in a vision of the night. Then Daniel blessed the God of heaven."

questions.question: In the dream, what was the head of the image made of?
questions.explanation: Daniel 2:32 (ESV): "The head of this image was of fine gold,"

questions.question: What struck the image and broke it in pieces?
options: A stone cut out by no human hand
questions.correctAnswer: A stone cut out by no human hand
questions.explanation: Daniel 2:34 (ESV): "a stone was cut out by no human hand, and it struck the image"

questions.question: The stone that struck the image became a great mountain and filled what?
questions.explanation: Daniel 2:35 (ESV): "But the stone that struck the image became a great mountain and filled the whole earth."

questions.question: Who did Daniel ask to go to the king to seek time?
questions.explanation: Daniel 2:14 (ESV): "Then Daniel replied with prudence and discretion to Arioch, the captain of the king's guard"

questions.question: After the head of gold, another kingdom inferior to you shall arise, and yet a third kingdom of what?
questions.explanation: Daniel 2:39 (ESV): "After you shall arise another kingdom inferior to you, and yet a third kingdom of bronze,"

questions.question: The fourth kingdom shall be strong as what?
questions.explanation: Daniel 2:40 (ESV): "And there shall be a fourth kingdom, strong as iron,"

questions.question: In the days of those kings, the God of heaven will set up a kingdom that shall never be what?
questions.explanation: Daniel 2:44 (ESV): "And in the days of those kings the God of heaven will set up a kingdom that shall never be destroyed,"

questions.question: What language did the Chaldeans speak to the king in?
questions.explanation: Daniel 2:4 (ESV): "Then the Chaldeans said to the king in Aramaic,"

questions.question: What did the king do to Daniel after he interpreted the dream?
options: He fell on his face and paid homage to Daniel
He gave him a gold chain
questions.correctAnswer: He fell on his face and paid homage to Daniel
questions.explanation: Daniel 2:46 (ESV): "Then King Nebuchadnezzar fell on his face and paid homage to Daniel,"

questions.question: The feet and toes were partly of potter's clay and partly of what?
questions.explanation: Daniel 2:41 (ESV): "the feet and toes, partly of potter's clay and partly of iron,"

questions.question: Daniel urged his companions to seek mercy from the God of heaven so that they might not what?
options: Perish with the rest of the wise men
questions.correctAnswer: Perish with the rest of the wise men
questions.explanation: Daniel 2:18 (ESV): "and told them to seek mercy from the God of heaven concerning this mystery, so that Daniel and his companions might not perish with the rest of the wise men of Babylon."

questions.question: According to Daniel, to whom does wisdom and might belong?
questions.explanation: Daniel 2:20 (ESV): "Blessed be the name of God forever and ever, to whom belong wisdom and might."

key_verse_text: And in the days of those kings the God of heaven will set up a kingdom that shall never be destroyed, nor shall the kingdom be left to another people. It shall break in pieces all these kingdoms and bring them to an end, and it shall stand forever.
